subject: Career-slate alignment: evidence handoff & LRB slot request (Priya N.)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Career-slate alignment: evidence handoff & LRB slot request (Priya N.)

Hi team,

I'm pulling together the career slate for Priya (IC, Infra) and want to align on the evidence packet and a preferred Level Review Board (LRB) slot. Draft writeup and an evidence matrix are attached — please treat as confidential. Key asks: 

- Quick pass on the writeup language by EOD Thu (I flagged a couple of quantitative metrics that need tightening).
- Check the evidence matrix for missing customer impact items (column D) and add 1–2 short links if you have them.
- Confirm any conflicts before I submit the LRB slot request (I tentatively queued May 3, 9:00–9:30 PT).

I've attached: Priya_Natarajan_writeup_v1.docx and evidence_matrix_q2.xlsx. Also included a short redaction_notes.txt with items I'd like to remove for the committee packet.

If we can finalize the writeup and matrix by end of day Thursday I will request the official slot and route to PeopleOps for the conflict-of-interest check.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Eng Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Career-slate alignment: evidence handoff & LRB slot request (Priya N.)

Lauren —

Thanks for starting this. Quick inline notes: 

> Draft writeup and an evidence matrix are attached — please treat as confidential.

+ Agree. I made two small wording tweaks in the intro (attached comments in the doc).

> Check the evidence matrix for missing customer impact items (column D)

+ Added a reference to the multi-tenant throughput benchmark we ran (row 7) and a short note about the rollback we avoided on 2027-02-10 (customer-facing incident).

> Confirm any conflicts before I submit the LRB slot request

+ No conflicts from my side. One ask: can we redact the specific customer name in the incident note (see redaction_notes.txt)? Better to keep the committee focused on impact not vendor details.

Attaching: Priya_Natarajan_writeup_v1.docx (comments) and evidence_matrix_q2.xlsx (updated).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Reliability
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, PeopleOps <peopleops@peopledocs.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Career-slate alignment: evidence handoff & LRB slot request (Priya N.)

Team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Two operational notes before the slot request: 

1) PeopleOps — can you run a COI (conflict-of-interest) check for Priya's packet against the current reviewer list? Please flag any reviewer who has been an active collaborator on the microservices rewrite in the last 18 months.

2) Redaction: I support Marcus — redact customer-identifying details from the public packet. Put a sanitized one-line summary (e.g., "mitigated rollback impacting multi-tenant throughput") in the version the committee sees. Keep the full incident timeline in the confidential folder for HR.

3) Scheduling: May 3, 09:00–09:30 PT is available on the LRB calendar but it's a tight slot. If PeopleOps advises a longer discussion we should propose 09:00–09:45. I've cc'd Hannah to confirm panel coverage.

Lauren — once you post the sanitized packet to the shared Drive, can you include the Drive link and the LRB calendar ICS in the submission so PeopleOps can attach them to the agenda?

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Engineering, Compute
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: PeopleOps <peopleops@peopledocs.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-23T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Career-slate alignment: evidence handoff & LRB slot request (Priya N.)

Hi PeopleOps / team —

Thanks for the quick reviews. I've pushed a sanitized packet to Drive (link below) and attached the sanitized writeup and matrix. Redaction notes applied: customer names replaced with generic descriptors; incident details summarized to preserve confidential context.

Attachments: Priya_Natarajan_writeup_v1.docx (sanitized), evidence_matrix_q2.xlsx (sanitized), redaction_notes.txt.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cX-example-slates
LRB slot request: I've tentatively requested May 3, 09:00–09:30 PT (LRB_calendar_event:ev_2027_05_03_09). Attaching an LRB_slot_request.ics to the formal submission.

PeopleOps — please confirm the COI check and whether the 30m slot looks sufficient. If you recommend 45m I can re-request and let the panel know.

Next steps I will take after COI clear: route to reviewers, upload evidence bundle to the confidential share, and send calendar invites to panel + Priya (quiet copy to Priya only after PeopleOps signs off).

—Lauren
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, PeopleOps <peopleops@peopledocs.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Career-slate alignment: evidence handoff & LRB slot request (Priya N.)

Thanks all — quick update from my side: 

- COI check complete: PeopleOps confirmed no panel conflicts; two potential reviewers were flagged but both recused themselves earlier this quarter so we are clear.
- 30-minute slot is fine for an initial slate read; I asked PeopleOps to set a 45-minute buffer on the calendar in case follow-ups are needed (they will not block reviewer time unless we ask).
- I reviewed the sanitized packet and the incident summary looks good — preserves impact without naming customers.

Lauren — please go ahead and finalize the submission. Once PeopleOps adds the ICS and the Drive link to the LRB agenda I'll send a quick note to panel members with the read-ahead.

Audio/tech logistics: Marcus / Logan, please confirm if you want me to reserve the small conference room with overflow video (Room B) for the panel — I can do that after the slot is locked.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, People & Talent Operations
